reason: On a SQLite supervisor Core, reserve_butler_session, report sign-off and delete_archived_engagement issued a textual BEGIN IMMEDIATE that the execution worker's SQL scope refuses, so opening Butler, signing off a report and deleting an archived project returned 500. The scope already begins every SQLite worker transaction with BEGIN IMMEDIATE, so the textual lock is now taken only when execution_runtime_id is None, as the store's other SQLite locks already do. Selected: the new worker tests in test_execution_worker_write_locks.py (each SQLite case fails on main), test_execution_scope.py for the guard, and the Butler session, report sign-off and Butler report tests that pass on main and exercise the changed lock paths outside workers.
exclusions: Individual tests are selected in test_butler_sessions.py, test_report_signoff.py and test_butler_reports.py because 4 of their cases fail identically on pristine origin/main (un-awaited test client calls). test_archived_project_deletion.py is excluded for the same reason (all 11 cases fail on main); archived deletion in a worker is covered by the new test. The supervisor-mode journeys were checked on scratch SQLite Cores instead (Butler open, report sign-off and archived delete returned 500 on main, and 200/200/204 on this branch). No UI, native or frontend code changed. PostgreSQL variants run only where NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL is set.
